Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- Added on 05/06/2011; Timezone conversion code;
declare
 v_local_time date;
begin
--
-- Invalid date is trapped by on_error. On_error routine will Popup an error screen, if you try
-- to display another error using show_error. On_error is invoked the first time that the contents 
-- of the date field is referenced, so this section of code just checks for date format errors using the
-- on_error checks.
--
 begin
 :GLOBAL.date := to_char(:licensed_products.eff_date, 'MM-DD-YYYY');
 exception
 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
--
 if (:licensed_products.eff_date is null) then
 show_error ('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--- Timezone-- 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 
 if (:system.record_status in ('INSERT', 'NEW')) then
 if (:licensed_products.eff_date < trunc(v_local_time)) then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 else -- timezone
 if (:system.record_status in ('INSERT', 'NEW')) then
 if (:licensed_products.eff_date < trunc(sysdate)) then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if; -- Timezone -- ends 
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
--message('Local On error: '||:Global.Error_count); pause; --- tmppp
--CHECK_DATE_VALIDATION;
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

select vp.product_code, substr(vp.product_desc,1,200) product_desc
from valid_products vp 
where 
sysdate between vp.eff_date and nvl(vp.term_date, sysdate+1)
